gap: BHD IS CLEAN, proven with a positive control, so this is a design verdict not leakage. Raw diff vs baseline-*.png with the BHD key forced at document-start: customer 268,447/5,184,000 (5.18%), invoice 529,726 (10.22%), dashboard 581,470 (11.22%), dashboard-390 235,698/1,316,640 (17.90%) - all DATA. I looked: the baseline reads 'Meridian Supply Group' / user 'Sam' with 6 international clients and an EMPTY invoice list; today's DB reads 'Paper & Pen' / user 'Wave' with 10 Oman clients and 10 invoices. Teal #009bc1, the 220px labelled sidebar, the UPPERCASE sort-caret headers and the outlined Company pills are pixel-identical in position. The decisive same-session A/B (BHD forced, wave sheet enabled vs disabled) is 0 differing px on customer, invoice, dashboard-1440 and dashboard-390; the identical toggle under the pnp key changes 1,106,547 / 1,594,962 / 1,320,583 / 180,874 px (21.3-30.8%), so the mechanism is real and the zeros mean something. METHOD: an attribute-only override is not enough - PRODUCT_KEY is read at module load, so force window.__ERP_PRODUCT via a defineProperty getter in addInitScript (index.html's own stamp then writes the forced key) plus a MutationObserver; measured, that lights up wave-col-uniform on 10/10 Payment cells. THE DESIGN: r7's decisive defect is genuinely fixed and fixed well. Measured on /invoice at 1440: Total and Paid each right-align at ONE painted edge on all ten rows (847.6 and 1000.7, spread 0.0) with tabular-nums and font-feature-settings 'tnum', the currency mark parked in a fixed 19.6px left gutter, so 123,456.789 and 7.500 share a decimal edge and 15,420.750 USD no longer hangs into the neighbour. Row heights 72px x10 spread 0.0, header #f1f4f9 13px/600 sentence-case, hairline #e8edf5 rules, no vertical rules, no zebra, one white container, no ping-right shadow, no clipped column, client ellipsised at 'Al Manara Integrated Fac...'. That table body is better than the bar's, which never shows a money column at all. It still does not clearly win, for three reasons and only one of them is new. (1) NEW, and on the same axis that decided r7: the money column headers do not sit over their own numbers. Measured, both 'Total' and 'Paid' are text-align:right but the th content box ends 16.0px inboard of the td content box (831.6 vs 847.6, 984.7 vs 1000.7), so on both money columns the label floats 16px left of the digits it names. The numbers are straight; the header is not on the same edge. (2) The toolbar. Wave's control row is three IDENTICAL outlined blue pills (Filter, Sort, Auto updates) beside one white field. Ours puts five different weights in one row: a white bordered Search field, a GREY-FILLED Filter select, a white outlined Export to Excel, a borderless dark toggle labelled Show Deleted, a white outlined Refresh, and a solid blue Add New Invoice - and /customer adds three unlabelled icon-only squares (two density toggles plus a bare gear) where the bar labels every pill. Export to Excel and Show Deleted in the primary control row read internal-admin, not expensive. Above it a caption sentence plus six summary cards push the first row to y=359. (3) At 390 it stops being a financial table. The KPI strip is a horizontal scroller with scrollWidth 882 inside clientWidth 370 - 58% of it is off-screen, cut mid-word at the viewport edge ('Partially Paid  (0.0') with no fade or affordance - the first invoice card starts at y=422, exactly half of an 844px viewport, and the padlocked 40x40 z-1050 'AI Assistant (locked)' FAB at x338-378 still floats over the card column, which runs x24-366. NOT counted against it: the bottom-right island is the TanStack Query devtools button (dev only); 'Evidence Incomplete' on 10/10 rows and the five 0/10 cards are local seed data, and the wave-col-uniform gate already fires on all ten of those cells and mutes them. Fix the 16px header/number edge on Total and Paid, collapse the toolbar to one control weight, and give the phone a strip that is not 58% hidden, and this wins.
